name: cmd_ring_push
note: Push command+param on the helper ring; drops when full

name: palette_fade_step
note: One palette, one brightness step, sets or clears its done bit (bit 31-index)

name: palette_fade_all
note: All banks: step and sum done masks; sum -4 means all black. Includes 0x183f8 bank loop

name: route_fade_out_wait
note: Route wait: set ff837b, push 0x800, sleep until cleared, two object-clear frames. MAME-measured durations in route_wait_test

name: fade_helper_task
note: Helper task: starts the palette child, polls ff8378, clears palette RAM, settle sleep, clears ff837b

name: fade_out_child
note: Palette fade task, darken per sleep until sum -4, then two flip frames, sets ff8378

name: gameplay_loop_task
note: See notes: tick loop, input latch, route dispatch, exit

name: idle_task
note: Fast-forward decrement and helper command ring drain

name: pool_alloc
note: Free-stack pop, tag 4. No clear on alloc; 0 when empty

name: pool_alloc_ffe280
note: Alloc, second tag 0x18 pool at ffe280

name: pool_release
note: Clear lifecycle longs, push slot, tag 4; +8 tag and +40 health survive

name: pools_reset
note: Round reset: wipe pools, set tags, fill stacks, clear globals. Some globals named only by address

name: pool_traverse_tag4
note: Dispatch active slots by class; tick order from 849e

name: pool_traverse_tag20
note: Clears three per-player words and ff221c, then dispatch

name: spawn_table_step
note: Camera-driven 16-byte spawn table; filter by difficulty and form; full pool retries next tick

name: damage_apply
note: Enemy path 1d518 and player path 1d59e; table damage, halving, floors. a4 save at ff189a is register housekeeping, not modelled

name: player_energy_drain
note: Player special cost by +9f; under 6 becomes 0; latches +42

name: pickup_heal
note: Heal from table, 5 base at 0, cap 0x65; at full scores through abdd2

name: hit_commit_single
note: Hitstop to both sides, id at +2d, reaction facing, five effect calls

name: hit_commit_per_row
note: Same, id by signed +65, negative records none

name: emitter_tick
note: Tag 28 class 0x0e: every 49 ticks spawns tag 24 class 0x10 variant 4 at its position; pauses on three globals
